subject.title: WhatsApp group messages never reach inbound handling (LID groups?) — DMs work; repro across relink + 2026.6.11→2026.7.1

question: Should WhatsApp adopt a Desktop browser identity by default, and how should existing accounts paired with the current `openclaw`/`cli` identity be migrated?
rationale: The apparent runtime fix is narrow, but the browser identity is recorded during pairing and changing it can invalidate active sessions, so code alone cannot choose the acceptable upgrade and operator-action policy.

options.title: Desktop default with guided re-pair
options.body: Switch new pairings to the Desktop identity and add doctor/setup detection plus clear re-pair instructions for existing incompatible sessions.

options.title: Opt-in Desktop identity
options.body: Preserve the current default and expose an explicit compatibility setting, avoiding forced migration but leaving affected group setups silently broken until configured and re-paired.

options.title: Wait for upstream confirmation
options.body: Keep the existing identity until Baileys or broader live-account testing establishes a supported migration path, while documenting the known workaround.

recommendation.title: Desktop default with guided re-pair
recommendation.body: Switch new pairings to the Desktop identity and add doctor/setup detection plus clear re-pair instructions for existing incompatible sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is on the WhatsApp login and socket-creation boundary where the pairing identity is applied.
